_read_first: assets/pillars/PILLAR-PROFILES.md  || 2026-08-12: every pillar now carries measured_spread - read open_grammar and text_register BEFORE writing a shot list (file 31 PART H). The hook ceiling in planqc 9 is now per-pillar from first_cut_median_s, not a global 2.0s.

car_cinematic._blend_note: frame-level study corrects the earlier 27% heuristic: azmiedtz 1/16 (6%), d2_shots 5/15 (33%). Most cuts are HARD at 33-67ms. Blends are RARE and DELIBERATE - 240-560ms wide, used as section punctuation, not as a default.
car_cinematic._burst_pattern: cuts arrive in bursts one beat apart (0.40s at 145.8 BPM) then hold. Not a uniform cut rate.

style.brightness_source: MEASURED — 9 WRX source clips read 46.8-81.2 mean luma; band set with headroom. Night, hard artificial key.
style.motion_source: MEASURED — 1.5 from 9 WRX/LC300 clips; EVENT 4.0 from the approved Supra probe (4.11).
style.shot_match_source: MEASURED 2026-08-05 on KK v14 + his three raw Higgsfield clips. He called clips measuring 45.1, 89.7 and 92.9 mean luma 'close to perfect' - a 47-luma spread INSIDE his approval band. A global median pull therefore destroys the look he approves: kk_I arrived at 45.1 and the old stage rendered it at 116.9. Source lighting is TRUSTED; the stage now only shaves excess CUT-BOUNDARY swing.
style.shot_match_clamp_note: Second belt only. The BINDING limit is now shot_match_max_move, stated in luma. The old note claiming widening this to 0.26 'made exposure worse' is SUPERSEDED: that test ran on a gain formula miscalibrated 2.2x, so a wider clamp simply overshot further. Re-derive if needed.
style._exposure_max_swing_why: Was hard-coded as `if d > 18` inside verify.py check 5 with no provenance. Lifted here 2026-08-08 UNCHANGED so behaviour is identical - the point of this move is that the number is now visible and per-pillar, not that it is right. travel_vlog runs golden hour to night by design and almost certainly needs a wider budget; car_cinematic is one light state and may need less. Neither has been derived. See ledgers/thresholds.json.

measured_spread._what: MEASURED 2026-08-12 from this pillar's own reference files. The single cuts_per_min figure above is a CENTRE OF MASS - these references disagree with each other by ~3x. A plan outside the band owes a reason, not an apology (planqc 2 reports, does not block, on whole-clip films).
measured_spread.open_grammar: a STILL, HELD. These films breathe 3-6s before the first cut; opening motion measures 0.08-0.88x the film's own mean.
measured_spread.text_register: huge display type filling the frame, letters cropped by the frame edge - a design element, never a subtitle

picture_baseline._what: PICTURE + STRUCTURE baseline derived from this pillar's own reference films (assets/refs/<pillar>/*.mp4). His instruction 2026-08-12: the references are the baseline for the PLANNING and ROUGH-CUT phases. Judging new work against our own past films (the old verify default was hardcoded to lc300) grandfathers our defects in as normal.
picture_baseline._scope_excludes_audio: AUDIO IS NOT BASELINED HERE. The reference files are platform re-encodes (2 of 6 peak above 0 dBFS), so they would bless clipping. Loudness/true-peak stay on platform spec and on his own tuning, which he has already dialled in - do not re-derive them.

car_cinematic_chill._what: DECLARED 2026-08-05 for the Toyota Crown Crossover KK build. Gavril asked for a 'car cinematic' that is CHILL and CRUISING. That contradicts car_cinematic's measured DNA (0.77s shots, 44.7 cuts/min, 140-170 BPM drift phonk), and the repo has already failed this exact brief once: ledger 'car cinematic' lessons 6 and 9 record a Crown build with a 90 BPM marimba bed and 1.33-2.67s shots, judged wrong on tempo, timbre and cut rate. The diagnosis then was 'too slow for the genre'. The honest diagnosis is DIFFERENT: it was slow with NO DECLARED GENRE, so it was measured against the aggressive profile and lost. This block gives the chill read its own numbers so it can be judged on its own terms.
car_cinematic_chill._not_measured: NO chill car footage has ever been generated or measured. Every number below is a STRUCTURAL CHOICE derived from two measured neighbours (car_cinematic n=5, travel_vlog n=6), not a measurement of chill references. Saying 'measured' about this would be the SMOOTH NUMBER trap. RE-DERIVE the whole block from the first real ingest, or from a proper reference scan of chill-cruise edits, whichever comes first.
car_cinematic_chill.lighting: golden into blue hour, natural key, car reflects rather than emits
car_cinematic_chill._why_between: cut rate sits BETWEEN its neighbours (car 44.7 / vlog 40.3 / here 38) and shot median above both short bands, because a cruise must read as unhurried without becoming a slideshow. Blends are KEPT at car level - a dissolve is how a cruise flows, and it is the one piece of car grammar chill actively needs. travel_vlog's 0% blends would make this a holiday reel.

style.brightness_source: PROVISIONAL — no chill/daylight car footage exists. Band copied from travel_vlog's widened range, which was itself widened on 2026-08-05 after a golden-hour/dusk frame measured 51.3 and would have been wrongly rejected. car_cinematic's night band [18,90] would REJECT every golden-hour clip in this build at 22.5cr each. style._edit_sfx_why: a whoosh on every cut is the phonk signature and it is exactly what makes a chill edit feel anxious. But 'none' was measured wrong for travel_vlog on 2026-08-05 - it silenced the car pass, which came out 2.8dB QUIETER than a random mid-video moment. hero_only is the shape that fits: no design on ordinary cuts, full design on the one hero moment.
style.motion_source: PROVISIONAL — taken from travel_vlog, which derived it from SYNTHETIC camera-move tests (slow landscape drift 1.18, serene push-in 3.38, locked-off 0.00). car_cinematic's 1.5 rejects a serene rolling shot, and a serene rolling shot IS this pillar's content. RE-DERIVE at first ingest.
style._sound_gate_why: NOT ambience. The whole story of this pillar's first build is a powertrain - silence, then the engine waking - so the car's own sound is the spine and file 19+04 must judge it before spend.

travel_vlog.note: MOSTLY HARD CUTS. 9.5% of cuts pooled across 6 references are DESIGNED, and every one of those is a WHIP - no wipes, no masks, no dips. At 19 boundaries that is 0-2 whips, which is why blend_max_count exists: a percentage band quantises to zero on a short cut.

travel_vlog.blended_pct_source: MEASURED 0% by a frame-difference heuristic that its own analysis (travel_vlog_ANALYSIS.md line 86) admits 'a very fast whip can read as a hard cut'. RE-MEASURED 2026-08-06 with tools/blendsense.py, which separates a WHIP (a sharpness trench of 2-6 frames WITH a scene change across it) from a hard cut (no trench) and a dissolve (sustained mid correlation). Result across the same 6 references: 3 WHIPS and 1 dissolve in 42 total cuts = 9.5% POOLED designed transitions, and 3 of 6 references use at least one. The old 0% was an UNDERCOUNT. Note the per-file medians are unusable here - two references have only 1 and 2 cuts - so the pooled figure is the honest one.

_style_schema._why: 2026-08-05. Before this block the CAR style was the invisible default: clipqc's night brightness band, engine's whoosh-on-every-cut, and planqc 19's car_cinematic scoping were hardcoded constants. A vlog plan did not get NO style - it silently INHERITED the car's. Style is now DECLARED per pillar and read by clipqc/engine/planqc. planqc 26 blocks any pillar that declares none.
_style_schema.brightness_band: [lo,hi] mean-luma band clipqc gates delivered windows against
_style_schema.brightness_source: MEASURED (with the evidence) or PROVISIONAL (re-derive at first ingest)
_style_schema.edit_sfx: full = transient design on EVERY cut (whoosh/impact) | hero_only = NO design on cuts, but the plan's ONE hero moment still gets sound | none = no edit sfx at all. 2026-08-05: 'none' was set for travel_vlog to stop phonk whooshes on a holiday — correct — but it also silenced the car pass, MEASURED at 2.8dB QUIETER than a random mid-video moment. The one event in the video was its quietest instant. A binary switch was the wrong shape.
_style_schema.sound_gate: diegetic = planqc 19 demands FOLEY+SOUND | ambience | underscore = speech-led
_style_schema.cut_spine: beat_grid | sentence — WHICH EDITOR builds it (family decides, this names it)
_style_schema.motion_floor: min mean motion of the DELIVERED window (clipqc). Car-tuned 1.5 rejects serene travel shots — MEASURED 2026-08-05: slow landscape drift reads 1.18, locked-off tripod 0.00.
_style_schema.event_motion_floor: min motion for the hook's EVENT window (clipqc).
_style_schema.card_max_words: max words per card. Was hardcoded 3 (label) / 5 (narrative) — car taste. travel_vlog's profile says captions are 'sentence fragments', and a real fragment ('SABAH, 1500 METRES UP') is 4 words.
_style_schema.shot_match_clamp: max ffmpeg brightness correction shot_match may apply. MEASURED 0.14 on the WRX. TESTED 0.26 for travel_vlog on 2026-08-05 and it made exposure WORSE: swings>18 went 9/19 -> 16/19, worst 52 -> 71. eq=brightness is not linear in mean luma, so a bigger clamp OVERSHOOTS dark segments past the target instead of meeting it. Reverted to the measured value everywhere. Do not raise this without re-measuring.
_style_schema.max_visits_per_place: max shots a single SOURCE may contribute. His catch 2026-08-05: 'alot of reused scenes'. MEASURED - framing duplicates went 3->0 between v3 and v11 while SAME-PLACE repeats stayed at 7 and loose place similarity went 12->13. Optimising framing does not reduce the feeling of repetition; only visiting more places does.
_style_schema.shot_match_mode: neighbour|median - neighbour never pulls to a global level
_style_schema.shot_match_max_move: max luma a single shot may be relit (the binding limit)
_style_schema.shot_match_tol: cut-boundary swing tolerated before a shot is touched
